characters.name: Edmund
characters.subject: Edmund, 26, assassinated royal naval prince returned as undead. Lean, tall (about 7.5 heads), angular tired handsome face, swept dark hair, strong brows. CRITICAL FACE: his anatomical LEFT half (viewer's right) is bare pale skull from eye socket to jaw with a turquoise flame in the socket; his anatomical RIGHT half is young human skin; the split runs vertically down the middle of the face. A NARROW GOLD CROWN visibly SNAPPED at the front (a gap with two sharp broken ends). Worn IVORY-WHITE PLATE ARMOUR with aged gold trim and a cracked crown badge on the chest; a torn PURPLE CAPE; a sword whose blade is cyan-green soulfire. THE SKULL HALF MUST BE CLEARLY VISIBLE in every image: bare bone with no skin from brow to jaw on the viewer's right side, exposed teeth along that half of the mouth, a turquoise flame burning in the empty socket; the boundary between skin and bone is a ragged vertical line down the centre of the face.
characters.pose: low-angle, standing his ground on wet rock, sword lowered in his right hand, left hand open toward the viewer as if giving an order, cape blown sideways.
characters.props: the soulfire sword; the broken crown shown alone.
characters.expressions: 1 controlled resolve (default), 2 cold fury, jaw set, flame flaring in the socket, 3 a wry, tired half-smile on the human side.
characters.build: tall and lean, long limbs, slightly hollow at the waist; carries himself like a commander who has stopped caring about his own body
characters.pose_v2: mid-stride down a wet slope, cape torn sideways by wind, sword trailing low in one hand, the other hand raised to halt the army behind him, head turned back over his shoulder

characters.name: Edmund (living)
characters.subject: Edmund, 25, the same man before death: same angular face, swept dark hair, strong brows, BOTH halves of the face fully human, healthy skin. An INTACT narrow gold crown. Clean ivory-white naval officer's plate and coat with gold trim and an intact crown badge, an intact purple cape.
characters.pose: on a ship's deck, one boot on a coil of rope, holding a rolled sea chart, looking out to sea, confident and a little impatient.
characters.props: rolled sea chart; small carved toy boat.
characters.build: tall, athletic, upright, broad open chest; the same man before death, healthier and lighter
characters.pose_v2: leaning on the ship rail with one boot up, laughing at someone off-frame, sea chart tucked under his arm

characters.name: Eleanor
characters.subject: Eleanor, 20, the Queen and Edmund's younger sister: family resemblance (dark hair, the same strong brows), sharp intelligent eyes, composed but watchful. Dark hair pinned up with loose strands. A slim gold crown with one red stone. Ivory court gown with gold edging and a deep crimson diagonal sash; practical long sleeves. She holds a small, visibly repaired wooden toy boat.
characters.pose: standing very straight at the top of palace steps, one hand holding the toy boat against her waist, the other resting on a ledger tucked under her arm, chin slightly raised.
characters.props: the repaired toy boat; a small ledger notebook; the crown shown alone.
characters.expressions: 1 composed, unreadable (default), 2 sharp suspicion, eyes narrowed, 3 brief unguarded warmth.
characters.build: slight and narrow-shouldered, very straight spine, still; small compared with the architecture around her
characters.pose_v2: seated sideways on a window seat, one knee drawn up under the gown, toy boat in her lap, looking out, ledger open beside her

characters.name: The Ferryman
characters.subject: The Ferryman: tall, faceless (only darkness inside the deep hood), wrapped in intact layered black and ash-grey ceremonial funeral vestments with worn gold wave-pattern borders; the hem dissolves into translucent floating tatters, with no feet visible. He carries a long wooden oar like a staff and a hanging iron lantern with a cyan-green flame. No skeleton, no species revealed.
characters.pose: floating slightly above dark water, oar held upright, lantern raised at shoulder height, head tilted as if listening.
characters.expressions: for a faceless figure use posture and lantern intensity: 1 still and patient, lantern low (default), 2 leaning in, lantern bright, 3 turning away, lantern dimmed.
characters.build: very tall and narrow, a vertical column of cloth that tapers into floating tatters
characters.pose_v2: bent forward over the oar like an old boatman, lantern held out low over the water, as if searching for someone

characters.name: King Aldric
characters.subject: King Aldric, 55, the late king: broad aging face with the family brows, silver-black beard, tired dutiful eyes. Sober white and gold court robe, dark purple mantle, heavy sun-medallion on a chain, a thick crown. Shown as he looked shortly before his illness, not as a corpse.
characters.pose: seated on a plain throne, one hand on a sealed document resting on his knee, the other gripping the armrest, gaze lowered.
characters.props: the royal seal; a sealed decree.
characters.expressions: 1 heavy, dutiful (default), 2 stern command, 3 quiet regret.
characters.build: heavy, broad, sagging shoulders; a big man diminished by illness
characters.pose_v2: slumped sideways in the throne, one hand covering his eyes, the other loosely holding a decree that is slipping

characters.name: Queen Beatrice
characters.subject: Queen Beatrice, the late queen, about 40: kind, intelligent coastal noblewoman, dark hair in a low braid, soft cream and marine blue-grey dress, a modest gold clasp shaped like a wave. Shown alive and well.
characters.pose: standing in an orchard, holding a shawl, smiling toward someone out of frame.
characters.build: medium height, soft rounded build, relaxed
characters.pose_v2: walking through the orchard holding her skirt up from the grass, turning to call back to the children

characters.name: Bernard
characters.subject: Captain Bernard, 49 at death, undead captain of the guard. Wide sturdy silhouette in battered steel-grey plate, an enclosed naval great-helm with a narrow visor slit glowing cyan-green, scratched crown insignia on the breastplate, a purple cloak, a dented round-cornered kite shield with a crown. Professional and grounded; no horns, no spikes.
characters.pose: planted like a wall, shield forward, sword low, helm turned slightly toward the viewer.
characters.props: dented shield; plain naval sword; an oil rag and a small notebook of names.
characters.expressions: for the visor, act with head angle, shoulders and visor glow: 1 at attention (default), 2 'permission to disagree': one gauntlet raised, head tilted, 3 offering a boon: holding out his shield-arm, glow bright.
characters.build: massive, square, low centre of gravity, wider than he is tall in armour
characters.pose_v2: kneeling on one knee to oil his helmet laid on his thigh, shield leaning against him, head lifting toward the viewer

characters.name: Matilda
characters.subject: Matilda, 38 at death, undead naval field surgeon. Compact sturdy build, auburn hair tied back, ASHEN grey skin with neat stitched seams on the jaw and neck, one wrist of bare bone, faint cyan-green light in the eyes. Patched brown leather surgical apron over a faded navy tunic, rolled sleeves, work gloves, a belt instrument roll. Clearly dead, never gory.
characters.pose: pulling a long curved needle and glowing thread taut between her hands, head cocked with professional interest.
characters.props: curved needle and thread; thread spool; surgical shears; instrument roll.
characters.expressions: 1 dry professional interest (default), 2 scolding a fidgeting patient, finger raised, 3 offering a boon: delighted, holding up the glowing thread.
characters.build: short, compact, strong forearms, wide stance
characters.pose_v2: sitting astride a crate, leaning in, sleeves rolled, biting a thread while stitching a patient's bone arm laid across her knee

characters.name: Oswin
characters.subject: Oswin, 43 at death, executed court scholar now a lich. A skull face with small cyan-green eye-lights under a short faded ink-blue hood, narrow stooped frame in a long grey scholar's robe with a leather belt, bony hands. Floating parchment fragments with diagrams circle him. He carries a cracked slate tablet. Solid feet; not floating; no crown, no huge staff.
characters.pose: reading a floating fragment with fascination while writing on the slate, one finger raised mid-argument.
characters.props: slate tablet; three parchment fragments with diagrams; a stub of chalk.
characters.expressions: 1 analytical (default), 2 indignant objection, 3 offering a boon: eager, diagrams glowing.
characters.build: thin, stooped, long neck and long fingers, almost bird-like
characters.pose_v2: perched on a stack of books, hunched forward, slate on his knees, one finger jabbing at a floating diagram

characters.name: Pip
characters.subject: Pip, 19 at death, undead ship's bugler from a fishing island. Lanky young ADULT (not a child), messy brown hair, ashen skin, the lower jaw bare bone in a permanent grin, cyan-green eyes. Short navy sailor's jacket with a wide collar, rust-red neckerchief, rolled sleeves, belt, boots. An oversized brass bugle with a small torn navy pennant bearing a broken gold crown.
characters.pose: mid-step, bugle swung up to his shoulder, other hand waving, grinning.
characters.expressions: 1 cheerful (default), 2 a joke landing, laughing, 3 offering a boon: blowing a short call, cheeks puffed.
characters.build: gangly and loose-jointed, all elbows and knees
characters.pose_v2: sitting on a rail with legs dangling, swinging the bugle by its cord, mid-joke, half-turned to an unseen audience

characters.name: Earl Roderick
characters.subject: Earl Roderick, 47, merchant noble of the harbours. Well-fed, pleasant, neat moustache, warm eyes that never stop calculating. Fur-edged navy and warm-brown merchant coat, gold chain of office, a red diagonal regency sash. Holds a ledger and a heavy customs seal.
characters.pose: leaning on a stack of cargo crates, ledger open, smiling as if offering a deal.
characters.props: ledger; customs seal; a purse of coins.
characters.expressions: 1 affable (default), 2 the smile freezing, 3 cornered, sweating.
characters.build: stout, round belly, short neck, fleshy hands
characters.pose_v2: leaning back in a cushioned chair with feet on a cargo chest, counting coins from palm to palm

characters.name: Countess Agnes
characters.subject: Countess Agnes, 44, keeper of the granaries. Lean, decisive, hair under a practical coif, a structured deep ochre and olive gown, a red regency sash, a heavy ring of warehouse keys at her belt, a wax tablet in hand.
characters.pose: standing in a granary doorway, keys in one fist, tablet raised like a shield.
characters.props: ring of keys; wax tablet and stylus; a sack of grain.
characters.expressions: 1 brisk (default), 2 cold refusal, 3 fear of famine showing through.
characters.pose_v2: striding through a granary aisle, keys swinging, pointing at a sack, coat tails flying

characters.name: Archbishop Anselm
characters.subject: Archbishop Anselm, 61. Tall, upright, gaunt; once a sincere almshouse priest. White vestments with a gold eight-rayed sun, a tall mitre, a red regency stole, an old worn prayer book and an official seal on a cord.
characters.pose: standing under a bell, prayer book held to his chest, other hand raised in blessing that looks like a warning.
characters.props: prayer book; official seal; a small bell.
characters.build: very tall, gaunt, slightly stooped from age
characters.pose_v2: kneeling alone in a dark chapel, hands clasped around the prayer book, a single shaft of light, face half in shadow

characters.name: Lord Marshal Hugh
characters.subject: Lord Marshal Hugh, 53, the prince's old sword teacher. Weathered soldier's face, short grey hair, short beard. Squared plain steel armour, navy mantle, red regency sash, a command pennant. A worn wooden training sword hangs at his belt next to his real blade.
characters.pose: standing at a fortress parapet, pennant planted, hand resting on the training sword, looking down at the sea.
characters.props: command pennant; practical longsword; worn wooden training sword.
characters.expressions: 1 professional calm (default), 2 commanding shout, 3 a teacher's grief he will not admit.
characters.build: thick-set veteran, heavy shoulders, slightly bow-legged from years in the saddle
characters.pose_v2: standing at a battlement with both hands resting on the pommel of the wooden training sword, staring at the sea, cloak heavy and still

characters.name: Lord Chancellor Walter
characters.subject: Lord Chancellor Walter, 52, the architect of the plot. Spare, neat, clean-shaven, thin silver hair, patient eyes. Restrained dark burgundy and charcoal official robes, a thin gold regency chain with a red bar, a seal case and a bundle of tied documents.
characters.pose: seated at a long council table, fingers steepled over a sealed document, perfectly still.
characters.props: seal case; tied bundle of documents; the royal seal.
characters.expressions: 1 polite patience (default), 2 a thin smile of control, 3 cold contempt.
characters.build: medium height, narrow, neat, almost no movement in his body
characters.pose_v2: standing behind a seated figure out of frame, one hand resting on the chair back, the other holding a sealed letter by one corner

pose_rules: Every character must read as a different silhouette: vary height, weight, width, posture and centre of gravity. Avoid the generic heroic contrapposto standing pose; prefer seated, leaning, kneeling, walking or working poses that show what the person does. Hands must be doing something specific. Head angle and gaze tell the attitude.
